_comment: RECURRENT-TIME-AXIS ablation of the round-1 deploy model (lisennet_conv_hardened_nc24). Single-variable swap: bottleneck conv -> hybrid replaces ONLY the inter-time dilated conv stack (_CausalTimeConv, RF 68) with a GRU over time (TimeGRU, unbounded RF); the encoder, decoder, intra-frequency conv mixer, batchnorm/relu/convtranspose hardening and n_blocks are identical. hidden_dim 18 sizes the GRU so params match the conv model to 0.3% (36,384 vs 36,288), so any quality delta is recurrence-vs-FIFO and not capacity. inter_kernel/inter_dilations are omitted: a GRU has no dilation schedule. Deploy: --streaming only (the stateless windowed graph is undefined for unbounded lookback); the GRU cell exports as 1x1 convs, so 0 GRU ops. Streams with 11 state tensors / 13k floats vs the conv model's 17 / 58k. Train into cp_lisennet_hybrid_nc24.
